mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DAILYLOOKS (dailylook_id, user_id, wear_date, description, file_id, canvas_json, created_by, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{dailylookId}, #{userId}, TO_DATE(#{wearDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{description}, #{fileId}, #{canvasJson}, #{userId}, 'Y', SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP)
INSERT INTO DAILYLOOK_ITEMS ( DAILYLOOK_ID, CLOTHES_ID, USER_ID, WEAR_DATE, CREATED_AT, CREATED_BY ) VALUES ( #{dailylookId}, #{clothesId}, #{userId}, #{wearDate}, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{userId} )
mapper.select: SELECT dailylook_id AS dailylookId, user_id AS userId, wear_date AS wearDate, description AS description, file_id AS fileId, canvas_json AS canvasJson FROM DAILYLOOKS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' OR IS_ACTIVE IS NULL) AND wear_date = TO_DATE(#{wearDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
mapper.update: UPDATE DAILYLOOKS SET description = #{description}, file_id = #{fileId}, canvas_json = #{canvasJson}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE dailylook_id = #{dailylookId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(dailylook_id, 8))), 0) + 1 FROM dailylooks WHERE SUBSTR(dailylook_id, 2, 6) = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYMMDD')

SELECT c.clothes_id AS clothesId, c.name AS name, i.s3_url AS imageUrl, COUNT(*) AS wearCount FROM dailylook_items di INNER JOIN dailylooks d ON di.dailylook_id = d.dailylook_id INNER JOIN clothes c ON di.clothes_id = c.clothes_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT ci.clothes_id, f.s3_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ci.clothes_id ORDER BY ci.created_at) AS rowrum FROM clothes_images ci INNER JOIN file_info f ON ci.file_id = f.file_id ) i ON c.clothes_id = i.clothes_id AND i.rowrum = 1 WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.is_active = 'Y' AND c.is_active = 'Y' GROUP BY c.clothes_id, c.name, i.s3_url ORDER BY wearCount DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT c.clothes_id AS clothesId, c.name AS name, i.s3_url AS imageUrl, COUNT(*) AS wearCount FROM dailylook_items di INNER JOIN dailylooks d ON di.dailylook_id = d.dailylook_id INNER JOIN clothes c ON di.clothes_id = c.clothes_id INNER JOIN ( SELECT ci.clothes_id, f.s3_url, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ci.clothes_id ORDER BY ci.created_at) AS rowrum FROM clothes_images ci INNER JOIN file_info f ON ci.file_id = f.file_id ) i ON c.clothes_id = i.clothes_id AND i.rowrum = 1 WHERE d.user_id = #{userId} AND d.is_active = 'Y' AND c.is_active = 'Y' AND TO_CHAR(d.wear_date, 'YYYY-MM') = #{yearMonth} GROUP BY c.clothes_id, c.name, i.s3_url ORDER BY wearCount DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE dailylooks SET is_active = 'N', updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE is_active = 'Y' AND TRUNC(wear_date) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dailylook_items di INNER JOIN clothes c ON di.clothes_id = c.clothes_id WHERE di.dailylook_id = dailylooks.dailylook_id AND c.clothes_id = #{clothesId} AND c.is_active = 'N' )
